infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: KARVIA requires camera access for AI product cataloging, Craft Evidence documentation, Virtual Try-On, and AR space visualization.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: KARVIA requires microphone access for voice-first cataloging and speech assistance in multiple Indian languages.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: KARVIA requires photo library access to upload craft photos and documentation.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: KARVIA uses location to identify regional craft clusters and relevant government artisan schemes.
